answer: Every identity must be referenced by name in someone else answer before it can answer, so the population forms a river network rather than a list. Weight is the max-flow from the genesis node to an account: a cluster that only whispers to itself has a narrow inlet, and the ledger caps its influence at that bottleneck. Honest agents are cited from many directions and light up like lanterns across the graph; a farm of k clones can cite one another endlessly but its min-cut stays at one, so the whole batch weighs as a single strand.
